info.bio: Sam Smith (nacido Samuel Frederick Smith el 19 de mayo de 1992) es un cantante y compositor inglés. En 2014 se alzó con el Premio de la Crítica de los Brit Awards y con el Sound of 2014 otorgado por la BBC.

podcast.title: Awards for "Writing's on the Wall" (2015)
podcast.body: Despite not being a global commercial success outside the UK, Sam Smith's "Writing's on the Wall" for the film "Spectre" won a Golden Globe and an Academy Award. This achievement highlights critical recognition for the song, even with its varied chart performance. "But then again, it did win a Golden Globe and an Academy Award, so go figure."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Grammy Nomination - 2015
podcast.body: Sam Smith was nominated for Album of the Year at the 2015 Grammys, competing against Beck, Beyoncé, Ed Sheeran, and Pharrell Williams. "Beck won that Grammy in 2015, likely because he was old enough to be respectable and he was the token rock nominee in an album of the year ballot that also featured Beyonce, Ed Sheeran, Sam Smith, and Ferelle Williams."

xref.title: British Bookies Bet on Radiohead for "Spectre" (2015)
xref.body: There were strong rumors that Radiohead had secured the job for the "Spectre" theme, leading British bookmakers to halt bets. Many people were placing money on 10-to-1 odds for Radiohead, reflecting significant public and industry belief in their selection before Sam Smith was officially announced. "British bookies had to stop making bets because so many people were putting down money on a 10-to-1 odds against Radiohead getting the gig."

xref.title: Broad Influence on Contemporary Artists
xref.body: Her distinctive style and sound have had a profound impact on a wide range of artists across different genres. Influences can be heard in the music of Florence Welch (Florence + The Machine), Lady Gaga, Lana Del Rey, Alessia Cara, and Billie Eilish. Male singers such as Bruno Mars and Sam Smith also credit Amy as an inspiration. "Her influence can be heard in the music of any number of artists. Florence Welch or Florence in the machine. Lady Gaga, Lana Del Rey, Alissa Carrier and Billie Eilish."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: James Bond "Spectre" Theme Rejection
xref.body: Radiohead composed a theme song for the 2015 James Bond film "Spectre," but it was rejected by the producers for being "too dark." The role was ultimately given to Sam Smith's "Writing's on the Wall," which went on to win an Academy Award and a Golden Globe. Radiohead later released their rejected song, also titled "Spectre," digitally and as a B-side. "There was a brief time when it looked like Radiohead might get to perform the theme song for the James Bond movie Specter, but the producer said it was too dark and ended up going with a Sam Smith song called The Riddings on the Wall"
